content.title: 56 Restaurants Open on Easter for a Hoppy Holiday
content.text: Whether you’re waking up early to attend church services or taking your kids out for an egg hunt, Easter is always a delightful but busy day. In other words, there are plenty of reasons why you might not feel like cooking. Luckily, lots of restaurants are open on the holiday and they’re ready to serve families who’d rather leave the cooking to someone else.Below, we’ve rounded up a comprehensive list of locations to help you plan your holiday feast on Sunday, April 5.&pizza Fans of &pizza can visit the restaurant on Easter.Applebee’sSelect Applebee’s restaurants nationwide will be open on Easter, with hours potentially varying by location.Black Sheep Coffee Black Sheep Coffee shops will be open on Easter.Buca di BeppoAll Buca di Beppo locations will be open on Easter from 11 a.m. — 9 p.m. for dine-in, takeout and delivery.Burger KingMost Burger King locations will be open on Easter.Chuck E. CheeseChuck E. Cheese will be open normal hours on the holiday.Cracker BarrelCracker Barrel will be open regular hours on April 5.Denny’sDenny’s restaurants will be open regular hours on Easter.Dickey's Barbecue PitDickey’s Barbecue Pit will be open normal hours on the holiday.Domino’sDomino’s restaurants will be open on the holiday.Donatos Pizza Donatos Pizza locations will be open on Easter, with hours varying by location.Eddie V’s Prime Seafood Eddie V’s restaurants will be open on Easter.Fazoli’s Some Fazoli’s locations will be open on Easter with limited hours, while some may be closed. Customers should check ahead for holiday hours.Firebirds Wood Fired GrillFirebirds Wood Fired Grill will be open from 10 a.m. — 10 p.m. on Easter.First WatchFirst Watch will be open on Easter.Fogo De Cháo Fogo De Cháo restaurants will be open between 11 a.m. — 9 p.m. local time on the holiday.Ford’s GarageFord’s Garage restaurants will be open on regular hours on Easter.Freddy’s Frozen Custard & Steakburgers Freddy’s Frozen Custard & Steakburgers restaurants will be open normal hours on Easter.Honey Baked Ham Honey Baked Ham locations will be open on Easter.JollibeeMany Jollibee locations nationwide will be open on Easter.
